title: Goal-Oriented Lower-Tail Calibration of Gaussian Processes for Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2605.20145v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Gaussian process (GP) predictive distributions are commonly used in Bayesian optimization (BO) to guide the selection of evaluation points for expensive objective functions. The choice of kernel and hyperparameters has a strong influence on the exploration--exploitation trade-off. For minimization, sampling criteria such as expected improvement (EI) depend on both the probability mass below the current best value and the shape of the predictive distribution in this region. translated_title: 面向目标的贝叶斯优化高斯过程下尾校准
translated_abstract: 高斯过程（GP）的预测分布通常被用于贝叶斯优化（BO）中，以指导对昂贵目标函数评估点的选择。核函数和超参数的选择对探索-利用权衡有着强烈的影响。对于最小化问题，期望改进（EI）等采样准则既依赖于低于当前最优值的概率质量，也依赖于预测分布在该区域的形状。本文研究了在无噪声设置下，针对超参数由最大似然法选取的标准GP模型，对GP预测分布在低阈值 $t$ 以下进行面向目标的校准。对于按参考测度 $\mu$ 分布的输入，我们考虑了 $t$ 以下两种互补的校准形式：设计空间上的发生校准，以及形如 $\{x\in\mathbb{X}, f(x)\l...$ 的下水平集上的阈值化 $\mu$-校准。
tldr: 本文针对贝叶斯优化中的高斯过程预测分布，提出在低阈值以下进行面向目标的校准，包括设计空间上的发生校准和下水平集上的阈值化 $\mu$-校准两种互补形式，以改进期望改进等采样准则对预测分布下尾的刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes goal-oriented lower-tail calibration of Gaussian process predictive distributions below a low threshold for Bayesian optimization, introducing two complementary forms—occurrence calibration over the design space and thresholded $\mu$-calibration on sublevel sets—to improve how sampling criteria such as expected improvement rely on the lower tail of the predictive distribution.
